metadata.description: Voynich Manuscript (Yale Beinecke MS 408) as one file: every page of the ZL3b transcription in book order, with its text, labels, drawing type and notes, and its Yale page image(s).

how_to_read.unit: paragraph = body text; label = word(s) next to a drawing; circle = text written round a ring; radius = text along a spoke
how_to_read.position: ZL3b position note for the line, e.g. clock position '09:00', compass 'N', or rosette 'circle:locus' like '2:11'
how_to_read.drawing_breaks: places where a drawing cuts through a line of text (<-> in ZL3b)
how_to_read.image_match: how the page was tied to its photo: 'Yale label', 'checked' (looked at), or 'page order' (foldout panels in the same order)
